'''William Jay''' is credited on 4 [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]]s as the source of the card image.<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited cards are in [[Virtual Set 7]], [[Virtual Set 19]] and [[Virtual Set 23]], sets dated 2017–2024 on this wiki. The credits on [[A Great Tactician Creates Plans / The Result Is Often Resentment]], [[Grand Admiral Thrawn (V) (ALT)|•Grand Admiral Thrawn (V) (AI)]], [[Not Within Sight Or Reach]] and [[Thrawn's Art Collection|•Thrawn's Art Collection]] are shared with [[Card Credits#Maeden Photography|Maeden Photography]]. The credit on [[Not Within Sight Or Reach]] is shared with [[Card Credits#Miquel Latour|Miquel Latour]].
